posts.author: riskin
posts.content_md:
does anyone know where a copy of Hand in Jewels by Robert Schinella may be found (other than in the collection of marion javits)? This is seth riskin of the MIT Museum and we wish to show this piece as an historical starting point for an holography exhibition that's going in our ground floor gallery windows this December. 

Thanks very much.

Seth

posts.author: BobH
posts.content_md: I heard from Gary Zellerbach that Robert Schinella passed away recently. I know that Ken Haines was good friends with him, perhaps he would know where to find a copy of that famous hologram.
